sys_job_offer.text: A recruiter calls with an offer: {{offer}}. Your current gig would be history.

sys_funeral.text: {{name}} is gone. Someone has to plan the funeral, and everyone is looking at you.

sys_arrest.text: Handcuffs. The charge is {{charge}}, and the prosecutor is asking for {{years}} years. How do you play it?

sys_pregnancy.text: Two lines on the test. You and {{name}} are expecting.

sys_conscription.text: You turned 18 and the draft letter arrived. Two years in uniform, or…

sys_deployment.text: Deployment orders. Your unit ships out next week.

sys_sponsorship.text: A brand slides into your DMs with a sponsorship deal worth ${{pay}}. They'd like you to pretend you've always used their product.

sys_award.text: You're nominated for an award. The gala is black tie and the odds are honest.

sys_paternity.text: A cousin makes a comment about {{name}}'s nose. It sticks with you.
